a long and successful career of over 40 years at AmeriServ Financial, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;), Michael D. Lynch, Executive Vice
President and Chief Financial Officer of the Company, announced that he will retire as of May 18, 2026. The Company is conducting a search
for his replacement.</span></p>
